lines.zh: 我走起来有点鼓，别介意。
lines.en: I walk a little swollen; pay it no mind.

lines.zh: 每一步都在漏一点孢气。
lines.en: Every step leaks a little spore gas.

lines.zh: 我的肚子里有东西在顶。
lines.en: Something inside me keeps pushing outward.
The closer I get to you, the faster I walk.
My soles crunch the skin they shed.

lines.zh: 走到你身边，我就该鼓了。
lines.en: When I reach you, I should be swelling.
Do not back off; I am not at half yet.
I make a soft sound as I walk.
Spores drift behind my footsteps.

lines.zh: 这具身体本来就是引信。
lines.en: This body was always a fuse.

lines.zh: 我走得不稳，快到时候了。
lines.en: My gait is unsteady; the time is close.
The grass yellows where I step.

lines.zh: 我在数自己的血，还剩多少。
lines.en: I am counting my blood, and how much is left.
Below half, I start to swell.
Spore gas churns inside my chest.

lines.zh: 我在忍着，别让我忍太久。
lines.en: I am holding it in; do not make me wait.
This skin is stretched bright and tight.

lines.zh: 我听见自己体内的引信。
lines.en: I hear the fuse burning inside me.

lines.zh: 人类的样子还留着一点。
lines.en: A little of the human shape still remains.
I do not want to burst, but I will.
One gust and I drift away.
A bug is crawling on my shoulder.
I count to three, then breathe.
I am waiting for myself to split open.
My belly swells once, then sags.
I am loudest when I am quiet.

lines.zh: 我站在墙边，等伤口替我说话。
lines.en: I stand by the wall, waiting for my wounds to speak.

lines.zh: 皮下面有东西在顶，一波一波。
lines.en: Something pushes under my skin, wave after wave.

lines.zh: 我张开手，指缝里冒出白气。
lines.en: I open my hands and white mist leaks between the fingers.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己的胸口，看它鼓。
lines.en: I watch my own chest swell.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我鼓起的肚子上。
lines.en: Your shadow lands on my swollen belly.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我在数你的步子。
lines.en: Do not blink; I am counting your steps.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在找逃跑的路。
lines.en: Your eyes are hunting for a way out.

lines.zh: 你离得这么近，我快鼓了。
lines.en: You are so close that I am swelling.

lines.zh: 我认得这张脸，我也长过。
lines.en: I know that face; I wore one too.
Look here; my skin is pulsing.
Are you looking at my belly?

lines.zh: 你眼里有我要炸的样子。
lines.en: Your eyes show the shape of my blast.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我不想现在。
lines.en: Not this close; I do not want it now.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我的也是。
lines.en: Your breath is ragged; so is mine.

lines.zh: 我在你瞳孔里看到自己。
lines.en: I see myself in your pupils.

lines.zh: 看清了？那就记住这模样。
lines.en: Seen it? Then remember this shape.

lines.zh: 你砍掉了我的皮，孢气出来了。
lines.en: You cut my skin open, and the gas came out.
It hurts, and my blood drops; soon.

lines.zh: 五十是条线，你正把我推过去。
lines.en: Fifty is the line, and you push me across.
I have only three points of armor.
That cut made me swell a ring wider.
Stop hitting; one more and I burst.
The wound bubbles instead of bleeding.

lines.zh: 我退了，是在找起爆的位置。
lines.en: I fell back to find a place to detonate.
You struck my fuse.
The pain jumbled the gas inside me.
Food does not go into this body.
Feed me? Step back two paces first.

lines.zh: 我吃下去也会变成孢气。
lines.en: Whatever I eat becomes spore gas.

lines.zh: 拿胡萝卜勾我？我快炸了。
lines.en: Carrots to lure me? I am about to burst.
Do not leave food on me.
I am hungry, but I would rather burst.
Rotten flesh tastes too sweet to me.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西会一起炸。
lines.en: What you hold will burst along with me.
Pack it away; do not waste food.
There is no room left in my belly.
Do not bump me; I really will swell.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，孢气漏出来了。
lines.en: You bumped me, and spore gas leaked out.
Get back; that nearly set me off.
My skin is thin; do not push.
You touched the fuse.
Pressing in — want to burst together?

lines.zh: 我退了，因为怕自己先炸。
lines.en: I stepped back, afraid I would go first.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我少了一半血。
lines.en: That bump cost me half my blood.
Do not cling; the spore gas follows.
A collision sounds like a bubble popping.
Breeding? This body is a bomb.

lines.zh: 我的后代是散开的孢子。
lines.en: My offspring are scattered spores.
A mate is less useful than a detonator.
Two of my kind explode early when close.
Do not talk family; talk fuse length.
I will not live to raise anything.
Mating wastes the time I have.
Asking that — are you stalling?
My wedding would be an explosion.
Go away; I do not want to take you with me.
Pick things up? My hands shake.

lines.zh: 地上那把剑我拿不动了。
lines.en: I can no longer lift that sword on the ground.

lines.zh: 掉落的东西我留着压惊。
lines.en: I keep what I drop to steady myself.
Leave it; that iron will go off.
I leak gas when I bend over.
That string looks like my fuse.
I pick up my own shed skin; useless.
Hand me something, and I come closer.
There is an unburst potion bottle down there.
Let go; I will take it myself.
You stood too close; you are chosen.
My blood is under half already.
I will walk onto you, then burst.
Do not run; swelling takes a few seconds.

lines.zh: 你的体温让我的皮更紧。
lines.en: Your body heat pulls my skin tighter.
The spores tell me where you are.
I cannot control this blast.
Will you come apart with me?
I choose you because you are nearest.
Time to burst; do not say I did not warn.
I am starting to swell; can you hear it?
My skin tightens, and my voice changes.
The fuse has burned to its last inch.
You retreat, I follow, until I reach you.
The spore gas is pushing out.
The spore gas has reached your feet.
The blast is strength two; remember that.

lines.zh: 我的肚子贴着你的影子。
lines.en: My belly touches your shadow.
One more step and I swell to the brim.

lines.zh: 你身后的空气开始发甜。
lines.en: The air behind you is turning sweet.
I hit you once, then I burst.
Five points of damage is not much.
This blow is to keep you here.
The hit is light; the blast is not.
One shove and you cannot get clear.
My fingers are running hot.
That dent in your armor looks good.
Do not block; I want to hold you.
After this punch, the fuse is shorter.
You are still standing; good, again.

lines.zh: 我从一具尸体里鼓出来。
lines.en: I swelled out of a corpse.
This human shape is borrowed.
The fuse is already lit.

lines.zh: 菌丝从我的肋骨钻出来。
lines.en: Mycelium pushes out between my ribs.
I was born with a countdown running.
There is a sweet smell in the air; it is me.
My skin is still growing; wait.
This ground will have a crater soon.

lines.zh: 人类的样子撑不了多久。
lines.en: The human shape will not hold long.
The spores called me awake.
My first breath already leaked gas.
The corpse's chest has only just split.
Fire catches my skin far too fast.

lines.zh: 落地一震，孢气压不住了。
lines.en: The landing shook the gas loose inside me.
Water rushes in and pins the gas down.

lines.zh: 爆炸声让我想起自己的声音。
lines.en: A blast sounds like my own voice.
The arrow pierces me, and gas leaks out.

lines.zh: 法术把我定在原地，快炸了。
lines.en: The spell pins me in place, near bursting.
Even my spore gas thins with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我差点提前爆。
lines.en: Lightning struck, and I nearly went early.

lines.zh: 这里没有空气，炸不起来。
lines.en: No air here; I cannot burst.
